basic_info.description: Just a short walk to Glen Park BART and the Glen Park Recreation Center. Featuring a brand-new roof! This beautifully remodeled home combines comfort, convenience, and style. This home offers an ideal layout for modern living. The main floor includes one bedroom and one bathroom, with the living, dining, and kitchen areas seamlessly connected, creating an open feel while still offering privacy when needed. Upstairs offers two bedrooms and an additional bathroom. Plenty of storage throughout the home. Gorgeously sized garage with a wide garage door,  utility sink, and a spacious storage room add even more functionality. The reimagined backyard provides a peaceful, serene setting, ideal for relaxing or entertaining. This home is a commuter's dream - easy access to freeways, public transit, local restaurants, and shops! Perfectly suited for a dynamic, on-the-go lifestyle. Don't miss the opportunity to make this gorgeous home yours in one of the sunniest neighborhoods in San Francisco!
